tasks.old_behavior: The ACL configuration parser only accepted 'dn', 'filter', and 'attrs' tokens in the 'to' clause. Any other token after these produced a syntax error.
tasks.new_behavior: The parser now accepts two new tokens in 'to' clauses: 'op=<operation>|<oid>' to restrict an ACL rule to a specific LDAP operation or extended operation, and 'control=<oid>' to restrict the rule to requests carrying a specific control. Invalid OIDs or unknown controls produce specific error messages (backward-compatible error paths).
tasks.compatibility_reason: Configuration files using 'op=' or 'control=' in ACL 'to' clauses will be rejected by older slapd versions as syntax errors. Tools that generate or modify slapd ACL configurations need to handle the new keywords. Old configurations without the new keywords remain fully compatible.
tasks.test_recommendation: Test parsing of valid and invalid 'op=' and 'control=' values. Verify that old configs without these keywords parse identically. Run 'test006-acls' which exercises the new ACL keywords.

tasks.old_behavior: The ACL evaluation loop iterated through all matching ACL entries and checked dn/filter/attrs only. All ACL entries were evaluated regardless of the operation type or controls present on the request.
tasks.new_behavior: Before checking dn/filter/attrs, the loop now checks if the ACL entry has op= or control= restrictions. If acl_op is set, the entry is skipped when the request operation type doesn't match (bitwise mask check). For extended operations, the OID must also match. If acl_control is set, the entry is skipped when the specified control is absent or has level <= SLAP_CONTROL_IGNORED.
tasks.compatibility_reason: ACL evaluation semantics change for entries using the new keywords: an ACL rule with 'op=search' will only match search operations, potentially granting or denying access differently than before. For entries without op/control restrictions, behavior is unchanged.
tasks.test_recommendation: Run test006-acls which exercises the op=search and control=manageDSAiT ACL rules. Test that ACLs with 'op=search' do not match add/delete/modify operations. Test that 'control=' correctly restricts to requests carrying the specified control.
